objective: Define the robot Linux-board and multi-MCU BSP V0.1 logical topology, ownership, interface allocation, IRQ rules, power boundaries, and freeze gates without claiming physical hardware validation.
acceptance: the document and manifest freeze one Linux board and six controller domains, including two robot-owned MCUs and four arm/tool module domains
logical peripherals have owners and IRQ/DMA allocation rules without invented pin numbers
multi-node CAN addressing and unresolved physical decisions are explicit
the document does not claim physical BSP bring-up or production safety approval
commands: python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('docs/architecture/robot-bsp-v0.1.md'); assert p.is_file() and 'six controller domains per robot' in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')"
stop_conditions: a physical part number or pin assignment is presented as confirmed without an owner source
the Linux board is allowed to bypass MCU-SAFETY
